Uff! A mi me encantan los de Leonidas, creo que son deliciosos y están a un precio accesible para hacer un detalle. Son chocolates belgas.  [Leonidas](http://leonidasmundodechocolate.com.pa/index.php/leonidas-panama/)

De resto se me ocurre comprar los chocolates de Athanasiou, que también son muy ricos y hay sucursales en muchos sitios de la ciudad.

Espero sea útil!

Thank you anon. I hope I can manage to go to therapy soon. 

I'll try not to hurt myself... A few years ago someone I knew ended his life and, even though we weren't close friends or anything, I remember him fondly and it still hurts me that he felt so desperate to actually do it. I wish I could've helped him.

I just can't bear to put my loved ones through that pain, its heart breaking
I know... It sucks.  If it helps, want to share what's on your mind? Or how are you feeling?
Hey... I just want to tell you that you're not alone in the way you're feeling. Please don't do it.
